cohort: The study included 1977 live births from women aged 15-49 years who delivered within the 2 years preceding the 2022 Nepal Demographic and Health Survey.
finding: Higher maternal education, wealth index, delivery in private institutions, and maternal age (35-49 years) were associated with increased odds of CS delivery, while rural residence and higher birth orders reduced the probability of CS.
mod_finding: Factors such as socio-economic status, maternal education, geographical region, and access to maternal health services significantly influenced the rates of caesarean section delivery in Nepal.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from the 2022 Nepal Demographic and Health Survey, covering births within the 2 years preceding the survey.
